novelty.justification: The core new-phenomenon claim is that a student can inherit a “conditional, trigger-gated” trait “without the trigger ever appearing in the training data,” characterized as a dormant backdoor rather than the always-on behavioral transfer in Subliminal Learning (Cloud et al., 2025). Searches for “conditional subliminal learning backdoor,” “trigger-gated subliminal distillation,” “backdoor trigger absent from training data,” and “conditional activation steering distillation” identified CAST (Programming Refusal with Conditional Activation Steering, 2024), Sleeper Agents-style conditional backdoors, and Channel Location Constrains the Auditability of Subliminal Learning (2026), whose masked sycophancy result already demonstrates transfer of a conditional behavior, but not deliberate inheritance of an attacker-chosen trigger-to-trait association wholly omitted from student data. The proposal is therefore a substantive multi-step integration and natural extension of conditional steering plus masked conditional transfer—not merely a renamed standard method—but the closest work makes conditional subliminal behavior predictable enough that it falls short of a wholly new core paradigm.
